Tony Weisman appointed President and CEO, succeeding Mark Douglas
MNTN expects Q4 revenue between $75 mln and $78 mln
Company sees Q4 adjusted EBITDA between $8 mln and $10 mln
MNTN forecasts 2026 revenue of $311 mln to $314 mln and adjusted EBITDA of $66 mln to $68 mln

CUSTOMER GROWTH - Active Performance TV customers grew approximately 32% yr/yr in the trailing twelve months ended September 30, 2026
